dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I can't find it anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: A book... Big Nine wrote it specially for me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I was playing with Big Nine before, he said he had a book for me.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I started reading it and got really into it... I was so into it that I didn't even notice when Big Nine left.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: I went to look for him but then I fell in the river... I made it out, finally, but then I lost the book...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, can you help me look for it? That book's really special to Big Nine, if I lose it he will be really sad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you know my name?

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: People talk about you all the time! And I keep seeing you everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: #Everyone says that {NICKNAME} is a very good person and can do anything! Can you help me find my book? Pleeeease?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's Big Nine?

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: He lives next door to me. We're both ninth in our family so our names both have nine in them. That's why we'd be the perfect match... Wait! Argh, no, don't tell Big Nine I said that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: The book was a present from him. He's gonna get it published, but he let me have a sneaky look at it first.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... where do I start?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... how am I gonna find it?

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Hmm, let's see... The river carried me a long way, I know that. The water was really cold, it froze my hands stiff...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: But I definitely didn't open it! I held it as tight as I could, because Big Nine told me how special it is...

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Finally, I crawled onto the river bank. The first thing I did was find somewhere to dry the book out in the sun.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: Then I was so exhausted that I lay down and fell asleep for a while. When I woke up, the book was gone.

dialogues.speaker: Little Nine
dialogues.text: It was in the woods over there that I dried the book out. You can have a look in there.
